reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.comment: We are extremely happy with this monitor! It was very easy to set up right out of the box, which made the whole process stress-free. My son has been using it regularly and hasn’t had any issues at all—everything runs smoothly and looks great. The curved screen is a nice touch and makes it more comfortable to use, especially for longer periods. Overall, we’re very satisfied with the quality and performance. Definitely a great purchase for the pr.
reviews.author: Justamomx3

reviews.title: Perfect for Gaming and Daily Use
reviews.comment: Great monitor for the price. The screen is clear, colors look good, and it’s perfect for gaming or everyday use. Setup was quick and easy. Overall, solid quality without spending a lot.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Lasted me 5 years before it begun its first wear and tear!
reviews.comment: Hello everyone! I bought this in 2022, and have it since writing this review and it has been an amazing monitor. I am now writing this review as one of the LED backlights has burned out and there is now this darkening bar in the middle of my screen. I personally will not be getting it fixed (I am lazy, do not want to fix it as it doesn't matter much to me) and will be continuing to use it until all the backlights just break on me. All of this to say! This has lasted me about 5 years until it started to show signs of wear, highly recommend and will be buying it again!
reviews.author: Aion

reviews.title: Outstanding Value and Excellent Picture Quality for PS5 Gaming
reviews.comment: Given the price, I am extremely impressed with this monitor. I purchased it primarily for use with my PlayStation 5, and the results have been fantastic. Setup required a little more effort than simply plugging it in, but once everything was configured properly, the monitor performed beautifully. The picture quality is excellent, the ultrawide curved display is very immersive, and the high refresh rate makes gameplay look incredibly smooth. For the price, this monitor offers outstanding value. If you are looking for an affordable gaming monitor with excellent image quality and performance, this is an excellent choice.
reviews.author: Graham S McLeod

reviews.title: Good enough.
reviews.comment: It works fine but it has noticeable image retention/screen burn. You will notice if after a while and it does get annoying. But it does work fine and at 120hz. It's very long, but this is surprisingly useful for multitasking. Though since there's a lot of complaints maybe I'm just lucky lol
